reuse.why: All consumers reuse the existing recurrence conversion and weekend-rule helpers, with holiday matching shared through isNonBusinessDay.

duplication.why: Weekend, holiday, and daily-skip decisions remain centralized rather than being copied into the calendar or budget consumers.

placement.why: Scheduling policy stays in shared/schedules.ts, configuration parsing stays in rule-utils.ts, and handler orchestration stays in schedules/app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested scheduling changes and their supporting types, tests, and release note.

maintainability.why: The shared policy is clear, although exported lookahead estimates couple consumer enumeration strategies to assumptions about excluded dates.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The existing and new consumers route date adjustment through applyWeekendRule or applyWeekendRuleToDay.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff shares non-business-day detection and adjustment without introducing reshaped copies of that logic.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains frequency and holidays, getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter, and daily-specific branches appear in applyWeekendRule and getNextDate's lookahead selection; no consumers bypass the shared policy.
